name: development-react
description: React framework topic plugin (foundation slice, #956). Composes ALONGSIDE development-javascript via /development:maintenance (a TOPIC plugin, like development-spring composes with development-java), triggered by the React marker — `react` in the runtime dependencies of any package.json — and only when javascript is also detected. This slice ships the composition wiring only: a real but tool-less gather (gather-react-findings.zsh) that places `react` in supported_topics, and a dispatcher stub returning a zero-group plan, reusing js-ci-fixer for CI remediation. The bootstrap templates (#957), the React Query + MSW API binding (#958), the review panel (#959), and the a11y/Playwright/Lighthouse quality tools (#960) land in later slices of #686.
